# Isaiah Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 143v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-vision [chazon] of-Yesha'yahu [Isaiah] son of-Amots [Amoz], which he-saw [chazah] concerning Yehudah and-Yerushalayim in-the-days of-Uzziyyahu [Uzziah], Yotam [Jotham], Achaz [Ahaz], Chizkiyyahu [Hezekiah], kings of-Yehudah.

**1:2** Hear [shimu], O-heavens [shamayim], and-give-ear [veha'azini], O-earth [erets]; for YHWH has-spoken [dibber]: "Sons [banim] I-have-reared [giddalti] and-raised [veromamti], and-they have-rebelled [pashe'u] against-me."

**1:3** "An-ox [shor] knows [yada] its-owner [qonehu], and-a-donkey [chamor] the-manger [evus] of-its-master [be'alav]; Yisra'el does-not know [lo yada], my-people [ammi] do-not understand [lo hitbonan]."

**1:11** "What to-me [is] the-multitude [rov] of-your-sacrifices [zivheikhem]?" says YHWH. "I-have-had-enough [sava'ti] of-burnt-offerings [olot] of-rams [eilim] and-fat [ve-chelev] of-fattened-beasts [meri'im]; and-blood [dam] of-bulls [parim] and-lambs [ukhvasim] and-goats [ve'attudim] I-do-not delight [lo chafatsti]."

**1:16** "Wash [rachatsu], make-yourselves-clean [hizzakku]; remove [hasiru] the-evil [roa] of-your-deeds [ma'aleleikhem] from-before my-eyes; cease [chidlu] doing-evil [hare'a]."

**1:17** "Learn [limdu] to-do-good [hetev]; seek [dirshu] justice [mishpat]; correct [ashru] the-oppressor [chamots]; defend [shiftu] the-orphan [yatom]; plead-for [rivu] the-widow [almanah]."

**1:18** "Come [lekhu] now [na] and-let-us-reason-together [venivvakhechah]," says YHWH. "If your-sins [chata'eikhem] are like-scarlet [ka-shanim], like-snow [ka-sheleg] they-will-be-white [yalbinu]; if they-are-red [ya'dimu] like-crimson [ka-tola], like-wool [ka-tsemer] they-will-be [yihyu]."

**1:21** How [eikhah] she-has-become [hayetah] a-harlot [le-zonah], the-faithful [ne'emanah] city [qiryah]! Full [mele'ati] of-justice [mishpat], righteousness [tsedeq] lodged [yalin] in-her — but-now [ve-attah] murderers [meratsechim].

**1:26** "And-I-will-restore [ve'ashivah] your-judges [shofetayikh] as-at-the-first [ke-varishonah], and-your-counselors [veyo'atsayikh] as-at-the-beginning [ke-vatechillah]. After-that you-will-be-called [yiqqare lakh] city of-righteousness [ir ha-tsedeq], faithful [ne'emanah] town [qiryah]."

**1:27** "Tsiyon in-justice [be-mishpat] will-be-redeemed [tippadeh], and-her-returning-ones [ve-shaveyha] in-righteousness [bi-tsdaqah]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "Hear, O heavens":** The cosmic summons — heaven and earth are called as witnesses to YHWH's case against Israel (cf. Deuteronomy 32:1). Isaiah opens with a covenant lawsuit.

**v.3 — "The ox knows... Israel does not":** Animals instinctively know their master; Israel cannot manage even animal-level discernment. The comparison is deliberately humiliating.

**v.18 — "Come, let us reason together":** *Nivvakhechah* — a legal term for arguing a case. Not a soft invitation to dialogue but a courtroom challenge. "Scarlet/snow" and "crimson/wool" offer radical transformation of guilt.

*— EMET*
